title: FEC Checker input
description: Validate a French FEC (Fichier des Écritures Comptables) against the format rules of article A47 A-1 of the Livre des procédures fiscales.

fecFile.title: FEC file
fecFile.description: Upload the FEC file (.txt or .csv, tab- or pipe-separated) or paste a public URL to it.

language.title: Report language
language.description: Language of the validation report and error messages.

includeAiReport.title: Include AI report
includeAiReport.description: Add an AI-written summary that explains the detected anomalies and suggests fixes.

fiscalYearEnd.title: Fiscal year end
fiscalYearEnd.description: Closing date of the fiscal year (YYYY-MM-DD). Lines dated after it are flagged as a risk signal. When empty, the date in the file name (SIRENFECAAAAMMJJ) is used.

fileName.title: Original file name
fileName.description: Name to check against the SIRENFECAAAAMMJJ.txt rule, for when the upload or URL does not keep the original name. Leave empty to use the name from the download.

maxIssuesPerRule.title: Max occurrences listed per rule
maxIssuesPerRule.description: Every occurrence is counted, but only this many are listed (with line numbers) for each rule, to keep the report readable.
